title: Moonshot Week orchestration and feedback loop notes v0.1
content:
Purpose and framing:
- Short: run a compact, high-engagement "Moonshot Week" to align on 3 cross-company bets, surface risks, and commit owners + measurable signals for Q2–Q4.
- Why "Moonshot"? Forces clarity on tradeoffs (what we will not do) and gives exec-level narrative for investors/customers. Keep tone pragmatic not buzzy.

Scope of the week (3 day core + pre/post work):
- Day 0 (pre-read): send one-pager per bet + baseline metrics dashboard.
- Day 1: Exec keynote (founders) + bet deep-dives (30m each) + breakout team synth sessions.
- Day 2: Prioritization workshop (decision matrix), ops & resourcing clinic, rollout intent + canaries.
- Day 3: All-hands: publicized commitments, customer spotlights, short Q&A, release calendar.
- Post-week: 30/60/90 execution cadences, weekly signal dashboard, and retro.

Draft OKR candidates to surface during week (explicit metrics and owners):
- OKR 1: Predictable inference economics
  - KR1.1: Reduce hosted p50 latency for T=1k tokens by 15% vs baseline (owner: Ricardo)
  - KR1.2: Improve cache hit rate for common prefix workload to 40% (owner: Maya)
  - KR1.3: Launch 2 quantized model variants with documented perf/cost delta (owner: Applied ML)

- OKR 2: Platform adoption and reliability
  - KR2.1: Increase active teams (monthly) on Dedicated offering from 6 -> 12 by EOW Q3 (owner: Jonah)
  - KR2.2: SLO attainment >99.7% for Dedicated clusters for 30d rolling (owner: SRE)
  - KR2.3: Reduce customer-reported incidents due to model mismatch by 50% (owner: Solutions Eng)

- OKR 3: Developer velocity & observability
  - KR3.1: Console adoption: enable per-route cost breakdown for 80% of active routes (owner: Product Console)
  - KR3.2: Ship lightweight evals-integration SDK + 3 reference evals (owner: DevX)

Questions we need answers to before week:
- Can we publish the baseline dashboards (privacy/legal check)? (action: Priya, due 2026-02-13)
- Which customers are ok to spotlight? Need release approvals (action: CS team)
- Exec time: Founders want 45m keynote + 30m prep for Q&A—confirm availability (action: Jonah)

All-hands run-of-show (compact 60 min public session):
- 0:00–0:05: Welcome + framing (founder)
- 0:05–0:20: 3 bet headlines (2.5m each) + one-slide signal (ops)
- 0:20–0:30: Customer vignette (pre-recorded) + 2m reaction from CS lead
- 0:30–0:45: Live demo: cost/latency dashboard + one optimization story (engineer)
- 0:45–0:55: Commitments & what to expect next (product lead)
- 0:55–1:00: Micro Q&A + close (founder)

Rehearsal plan (two run-throughs recommended):
- Dry run A (execs + speakers) 2 days before: focus on timing & choreography. Must hit 55 minute mark.
- Dry run B (full tech check) 1 day before: AV, captions, pre-recorded playback, Slack embed.
- On the day: staging room + one producer + two floor ops to triage live Qs.

Contingency and graceful degradation (the three triggers):
- Trigger A: Dashboard outage during demo -> fallback to static annotated screenshot + follow-up doc. Owner: Observability (Ricardo).
- Trigger B: Speaker no-show or sprint fire -> pre-recorded keynote short version (founders) to air + async Q&A. Owner: Exec assistant.
- Trigger C: Security/PR incident -> delay public all-hands; run an internal-only executive briefing within 24 hours. Owner: Security + Comms.

Feedback loop and measurement (how we'll know week worked):
- Engagement: Live attendance ratio target 60% of company; slack chorus (reactions count > 500).
- Alignment: Post-week survey: "I know the 3 bets and my team's primary signal" > 85% agree.
- Ops: All bet owners publish 30/60/90 cadence within 7 days.
- Exec: Board note + 2 minute board-ready summary produced within 3 business days.

Sticky decisions to finalize (owner + due):
- Publish bet one-pagers (Priya) — 2026-02-12
- Lock the 3 customer spotlights and approvals (CS lead) — 2026-02-14
- Confirm AV vendor for hybrid (Facilities) — 2026-02-16
- Allocate budget for external streaming infra if >2000 concurrent viewers (Finance) — 2026-02-16

Loose notes / to self (brain dump):
- Keep language concrete: avoid 'moonshot' romanticism in slides — use cost/latency graphs, concrete product impact statements.
- Consider a 'fail forward' callout per bet: what success looks like and what stop conditions are.
- Quick wins we can highlight: new batching heuristic landed in staging (PR #342), console cost breakdown prototype screenshot.
- Danger: Too many bets -> dilution. Aim for max 3. If teams push more, fold into 'enablers' panel.

Open items we still debate:
- Public vs internal: should we stream externally? Investors might tune in. Risk: early signals leak. (Recommendation: internal first, then edited recording for public).
- How to track cross-team dependencies without onerous weekly meetings? Proposal: one 30min triage with bet owners + product lead per week; centralized tracker in JIRA label MOON-xx.

Action checklist (short):
- [ ] Priya: finalize one-pagers + legal signoff (due 2026-02-12)
- [ ] Jonah: lock exec keynote time + draft script (due 2026-02-12)
- [ ] Ricardo: prepare demo dashboard fallback artifacts (due 2026-02-15)
- [ ] Maya: compile model perf baselines and attach to pre-reads (due 2026-02-13)
- [ ] CS: confirm customer spotlights and NDAs (due 2026-02-14)
- [ ] Facilities/IT: AV + streaming check + rehearsal room (due 2026-02-16)

Appendix: quick template for bet one-pager (use this for pre-read):
- Title (one line), owner(s), elevator pitch (2 sentences), why now (1 bullet), baseline metrics (3 numbers), principal risks (3), primary milestones (30/60/90), stop criteria, visible signals to publish in dashboard.

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally terse. Expect additional artifacts (slide deck, pre-read PDFs, JIRA epic) to be attached as we converge. Please comment inline on the bet definitions and KR clarity.

Unresolved: board narrative tone — founders want 'audacious but practical'. Would like feedback from Comms on wording by 2026-02-13.

-- end of draft (Asha)
